title: Axially Chiral Dodecanuclear Lanthanide Clusters Constructed by “Bottom-Up” Self-assembly for Enantioselective Sensing

material_class.structural_family: axially chiral dinuclear Eu phosphate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (0.027 g, 0.06 mmol), (R)-(+)-1,1'-binaphthyl-2,2'-diyl hydrogenphosphate (R-BNP, 0.010 g, 0.03 mmol), 2-fluorobenzoic acid (0.010 g, 0.07 mmol) and EtOH (1 mL) were combined in a 5 mL scintillation vial, sealed, and heated at 80 °C for 13 h. After cooling in air to room temperature, crystals were filtered and repeatedly washed with EtOH.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled in air to room temperature; crystals filtered and washed repeatedly with EtOH

properties.summary: R-1 and S-1 are enantiomers by nearly perfect mirror-image CD spectra in DMF (230–500 nm). R-1 shows negative Cotton effects near 262 and 319 nm and positive Cotton effects around 240 and 290 nm; split peaks near 240 and 262 nm are assigned to π–π* transitions of the aromatic groups. Solid-state CD further supports enantiomeric pairing.

material_class.structural_family: axially chiral dinuclear Eu phosphate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to R-1 except that R-BNP is replaced by S-BNP: Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (0.027 g, 0.06 mmol), S-BNP (0.010 g, 0.03 mmol), 2-fluorobenzoic acid (0.010 g, 0.07 mmol) and EtOH (1 mL) in a sealed 5 mL scintillation vial at 80 °C for 13 h, then cooled, filtered, and washed with EtOH.

reagents.name: (S)-1,1'-binaphthyl-2,2'-diyl hydrogenphosphate
reagents.amount: 0.010 g, 0.03 mmol (as for R-1, ligand replaced)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed 5 mL scintillation vial (method similar to R-1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: as for R-1: cooled, filtered, washed with EtOH

properties.summary: S-1 is the enantiomer of R-1; liquid CD in DMF is a nearly perfect mirror image of R-1, with opposite Cotton effects at the same wavelengths (240, 262, 290, 319 nm).

material_class.structural_family: axially chiral hexagonal-prism Eu12 oxalate–phosphate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Fresh R-1 crystals (5 mg) and oxalic acid (5 mg) in ethanol (1 mL) were placed in a 5 mL glass vial at 80 °C for 24 h. Colorless transparent crystals of R-2 were obtained and washed with ethanol (yield 27% based on R-1).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: colorless transparent crystals washed with ethanol

properties.summary: R-2 is highly fluorescent in DMF (emission maximum 613 nm; fluorescence lifetime <1 ns) and functions as an enantioselective fluorescence sensor for binaphthyl derivatives. Toward (R)/(S)-BINOL-TF2, Stern–Volmer Ksv = 1749 L mol−1 (S) and 1262 L mol−1 (R) (0–3×10−4 mol/L), QR = 1.36; enantioselectivity factors EF range from 1.03 to 2.87 (EF = 2.87 for R/S-BINOL-TF2). CD of R-2/S-2 is nearly mirror-image and peak positions match R-1/S-1. Quenching is attributed to competitive energy absorption rather than FRET.

measurements.name: emission maximum
measurements.conditions: R-2 in DMF, 1.0×10−5 mol/L; monitored for sensing

measurements.name: fluorescence lifetime
measurements.conditions: R-2 in DMF (Figures S15 and S16)

measurements.name: quenching ratio QR = Ksv(S)/Ksv(R)
measurements.conditions: BINOL-TF2 titration of R-2 in DMF

measurements.name: enantioselectivity factor EF
measurements.conditions: R/S-BINOL-TF2; EF range 1.03–2.87 for binaphthyl substrates

material_class.structural_family: axially chiral hexagonal-prism Eu12 oxalate–phosphate cluster

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to R-2 except that S-1 was used instead of R-1: S-1 (5 mg) and oxalic acid (5 mg) in ethanol (1 mL) in a 5 mL glass vial at 80 °C for 24 h; crystals washed with ethanol.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 5 mL glass vial (method similar to R-2)

properties.summary: S-2 is the enantiomer of R-2 (mirror-image CD). Opposite enantioselective fluorescence quenching of BINOL-TF2 relative to R-2 is observed, confirming stereoselective recognition.

measurements.name: enantioselective fluorescence quenching
measurements.value: opposite selectivity vs R-2 toward BINOL-TF2
